title: IRC: small cross-provider findings (PART reason dropped, invitee shown joined before accepting)
description: From irssi across two providers (2026-11-21): (1) PART #c :bye reaches others as PART #c :no longer in this room; the user's reason is dropped. (2) When bob invites alice, bob's channel shows alice JOIN at once (she is in the MLS group after the Commit), while alice still has a pending &invite-N she has not accepted. Accurate to MLS, possibly surprising; decide whether to show the invitee as joined only once she accepts.
